description: This file defines the SubjectInvalidException class, a custom exception indicating that a subject string is invalid according to specific validation rules. It includes constructors, static methods for creation and deserialization, and a nested builder class for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: SubjectInvalidException
classes.description: A specialized exception class indicating that a subject string is invalid, with support for JSON deserialization, message formatting, and builder pattern.

classes.name: SubjectInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of SubjectInvalidException with flexible configuration.
